user.title: Connect to SolisCloud
user.description: Use the API Key ID and API Secret from SolisCloud API Management. The default endpoint is the current v3 SolisCloud API endpoint.

error.invalid_auth: SolisCloud rejected the API credentials or signature. Check API access, Key ID and Secret.
error.no_inverters: No inverter was returned for this Station ID. Check the Station ID and API permissions.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the SolisCloud API. Check the API URL and your network connection.
error.api_error: SolisCloud returned an API error. Check Home Assistant logs for the exact response.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This SolisCloud Station ID is already configured.
